title: Roblox downloaded 145GB models from us (including adult content) without asking
hook_text: Roblox grabbed one hundred forty five gigabytes
script:
Roblox downloaded one hundred forty five gigabytes of models from Open3DLab without asking.
Open3DLab hosts user generated three d assets for developers and creators.
The unauthorized downloads included explicit adult content hosted on the platform.
Open3DLab founders discovered the massive traffic spike hitting their servers.
Server logs traced the data scraping activity directly back to Roblox infrastructure.
How should platforms handle unauthorized scraping of user assets?
